correctness.rationale: Each Wolfram rule r has a four-state de Bruijn graph with vertices 2-bit words ab and arcs ab→bc labeled rule(abc); cyclic inputs are exactly labeled closed walks, including n=1,2 repeated neighbors. A target word belongs to the one-step image iff the Boolean matrix product has a nonzero diagonal. The deterministic automaton of 4x4 Boolean relations has at most 2^16 states and accepts all word lengths. Exhaustive direct enumeration through length 8 partitions the 256 rules into 100 short-signature classes with profile 8 singletons,75 doubles,10 quadruples,3 sextuples,4 tenfold. Complete synchronized relation-automata BFS for all 156 representative-to-member pairs shows no longer distinguishing word: maximum visited product 2375 states for rules 22,104. Every unlike short-signature pair already differs by n<=8. Independently reconstructed all 256 direct image sets and the complete finite-product BFS; confirmed prefix counts (3,8,40,72,75,92,99,100), sharp pair 57,99 with target 00010011 from predecessor 11100101, and compact class table SHA256 8046dbeaba56d5cdec15119e6407b9c712af515a19d6c70adc31613f9a841cee. Finite-state exhaustion, not extrapolation from n<=8, certifies equality for all n.
residual_risks: Finite computation is exhaustive only for the specified 256 binary radius-one rules; verification depends on correctly implementing the finite relation automaton correspondence, whose proof is supplied. No claims about multi-update, nonperiodic or necklace outputs.
